body:
I manually set a few config values with the assumption that the defaults do not aim for accuracy.

In mupen64plus 2.6.0, use any of the HLE RSP plugins, then run Perfect Dark.

The emulator will start but with a stalled CPU and a memory leak (?), unless I set `detect_cpu_write = 0` (the default).

I figured that this could be some bug.
title: Perfect Dark does not start when `detect_cpu_write = 1`
